name: Ogazón (DE)
description: Ogazón (DE) is an artist who performs electronic music, moving between house and techno. The event starts at 11:59 PM and is scheduled to end at 6:00 AM.
longDescription:
Ogazón (DE) is an artist known for her electronic music performances, where she blends house and techno. Her approach focuses on the audience's experience, delivering performances with careful consideration.

The event takes place at Plano B in Porto, starting on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 11:59 PM and concluding at 6:00 AM on November 14. Tickets are priced at €10.61.

Admission is reserved, and ticket holders are not guaranteed entry to the club, though refunds will be issued in such cases. The ticket does not include any drinks.
